name: AIBS/SEU-ALLEN mouse neuron fMOST benchmark
description: This repository contains the 1,512-case AIBS/SEU-ALLEN mouse neuron fMOST benchmark used to evaluate PyTube. It includes local 3D image blocks, corresponding manual reconstructions, trace, and evaluation scripts. PyTube is available at https://github.com/YunZhixi98/pyTube
